title: Orbit and Colony Again
author: Xanthe Underhill
blurb: Elodie Sterling, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
